page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.6xlarge is a storage-focused virtual server instance within the ecs.d1 family, running on a KVM hypervisor. Powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor operating at 2.5 GHz, it provides 24 dedicated vCPUs. The hardware configuration includes 96.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio or 4.0 GB of RAM per core. A defining specification of this instance is its bundled local storage array totaling 70,866 GB of Hard Disk Drive (HDD) capacity, complemented by an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth profile.

This server architecture balances compute and memory against high local storage volume. Because the 70,866 GB storage capacity uses mechanical HDD media rather than NVMe SSDs, the hardware profile emphasizes high-capacity sequential data retention and dense storage over low-latency or high-IOPS random operations. Dedicated CPU allocation ensures steady computational capability, supporting sustained data processing without thread contention.

The ecs.d1.6xlarge instance fits workloads requiring large-scale local storage and baseline processing power. Relevant deployment scenarios include distributed file storage systems, log analytics pipelines, data warehousing, cold data archiving, and bulk batch ETL operations.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.6xlarge is a storage-dense virtual server designed for high-capacity data tasks. Powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 CPU at 2.5 GHz, the instance delivers 24 dedicated vCPUs and 96.0 GB of RAM, maintaining a 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio. Its core differentiator is a bundled local storage capacity of 70,866 GB HDD. Managed via a KVM hypervisor with an 8 Gbps baseline network interface, this instance offers an economical capacity footprint for volume storage. Although HDD media restricts random read/write throughput compared to solid-state alternatives, the extensive local disk capacity makes this instance well suited for large log processing systems, distributed storage nodes, cold data archiving, and offline batch ETL processing.
